question: Which of the following is the most dominant flora of the plant kingdom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Angiosperm**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• **Angiosperms** are the most diverse and widespread group of plants within the plant kingdom, comprising over 300,000 species.

• They are characterized by the presence of **flowers and fruit**, which are reproductive structures unique to this group.

• Angiosperms are found in a wide variety of habitats, including terrestrial and aquatic environments, and have adapted to almost every climatic condition.

• They play a crucial role in ecosystems by providing **food, oxygen, and habitat** for many other organisms, including humans.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Bryophyta**

• Also known as mosses and liverworts, bryophytes are non-vascular plants that are typically found in moist, shaded environments.

• They do not produce flowers or seeds and reproduce via spores.

• Bryophytes play an important role in preventing soil erosion and retaining moisture in ecosystems.

• **Gymnosperm**

• Gymnosperms are seed-producing plants that do not form flowers or fruits. Their seeds are exposed on cones or other structures.

• This group includes conifers, cycads, ginkgo, and gnetophytes.

• Gymnosperms are primarily found in temperate and boreal regions and are important for timber and paper production.

• **Pteridophyte**

• Pteridophytes are vascular plants that reproduce via spores rather than seeds. This group includes ferns and horsetails.

• They are found in a variety of habitats, from tropical rainforests to temperate woodlands.

• Pteridophytes are important in the study of plant evolution and are often used as ornamental plants.
